alt: Surgically targeted administrative Consumer Complaint filed with the California DMHC against L.A. Care Health Plan for timely access and grievance processing timeline violations regarding NEMT transport.
full_text: STATEMENT OF COMPLAINT: TIMELY ACCESS & GRIEVANCE TIMELINE VIOLATIONS. I am filing this formal Consumer Complaint against L.A. Care Health Plan for explicit violations of the Knox-Keene Act regarding timely access to care and statutory grievance processing timelines. 1. Timely Access Violation (March 16, 2026). On March 16, 2026, I attempted to utilize L.A. Care's mandated non-emergency medical transportation benefits to travel to the pharmacy to pick up a critical, time-sensitive prescription medication. The health plan's transportation phone lines subjected me to excessive, unlawful hold times, effectively denying my timely access to covered prescription services. 2. Statutory Grievance Violation (April 2026). I filed a timely, formal grievance with L.A. Care regarding this transportation and pharmacy access failure. L.A. Care acknowledged this grievance in a letter dated April 1, 2026, explicitly noting it was regarding Call The Car (CTC) transportation and CVS Pharmacy access issues. Under California law, health plans are strictly mandated to resolve standard grievances within 30 days. L.A. Care failed to meet this statutory deadline. 3. Plan Admission of Violation. On April 29, 2026, L.A. Care issued a formal written notice. In this letter, L.A. Care explicitly admitted in writing that they failed to meet the state-mandated 30-day processing deadline for my grievance, apologizing for the administrative delay. 4. Concurrent State Administrative Tracking. Please note that due to systemic administrative defaults and ongoing access issues by the plan, these transportation failures have also been documented under active State Hearing Appeal SHN-REDACTED55. This DMHC complaint is brought specifically to enforce regulatory compliance regarding the plan's clear timeline breaches. Remedy Requested. Because L.A. Care has a documented history of failing to provide timely administrative access and failing to adhere to statutory consumer protection timelines, I request that the DMHC formally investigate L.A. Care’s grievance department and order a corrective action plan to ensure strict compliance with the Knox-Keene Act.
summary: Surgically targeted administrative Consumer Complaint filed with the DMHC against L.A. Care Health Plan, documenting timely access and 30-day grievance timeline violations regarding NEMT transportation benefits. This standard complaint was improperly merged by the DMHC with a separate clinical IMR network crisis.
